$comment: 语法大厅 G40（V0.9 P3 进阶层）。比喻锚点：转述：人称、时态、时空三样各退一步。只讲初中层面（陈述/一般疑问/特殊疑问/祈使四类转述、时空词换算表、say/tell 分工、真理豁免），联动 G33 坐正与对表、G30 的 (not) to do。全部内容原创。
title: 直接引语与间接引语
metaphor: 转述：人称、时态、时空三样各退一步
ketNote: 老实说：KET 不考引语转换，A2 只要求看懂 He said (that)... 的简单句。系统的转述是初中和 PET 的重头戏——这课为它打底，学到就是赚到，不用焦虑。

sections.essence: 转述别人的话：人称、时态、时空三样各退一步，问句还要坐正。
sections.why: 直接引语是录音回放——引号里一个字不动；间接引语是你替他说——立场从他移到了你，于是三样东西都要换算：他嘴里的「我」，到你嘴里成了「他」（人称）；他说话时的「现在」，已经成了过去（时态退一步）；他的「今天」「这里」也离开了现场（today→that day，here→there）。中文转述只换人称：「他说他明天来」——「明天」和「来」一个都不动；英语三样全要换算，这正是初中转述题的核心。另外问句转述要坐正（G33），命令转述用 (not) to do（G30），say 和 tell 还要分家。
sections.metaphorStory: 银帆乐队的信使课。指挥对信使说：「I will rehearse here tomorrow.」信使跑去团长那儿，若原样复述就全乱了——信使不是指挥，说话的地方不是排练厅，日子也翻了篇。所以信使说：He said he would rehearse there the next day——三样各退一步：I 退成 he，will 退成 would，here 和 tomorrow 换算成 there 和 the next day。团长又让信使去问鼓手「Are you free?」，信使转达时把问句的手势收了起来：He asked if the drummer was free。最后传一道口令「Come early!」——信使说 He told him to come early。师傅总结：「转述就是换圆心——所有以『我、现在、这里』为圆心的词，一起平移。」

cards.detail: 人称换立场（I→he/she）；时态退一步（G33 的对表）；时空词换算（离开说话现场）。
cards.example: "I am busy now." → He said he was busy then.

cards.detail: am/is→was · are→were · do/does→did · will→would · can→could · have done→had done。主句是 says（现在）就不退。
cards.example: "I can swim." → He said he could swim.

cards.detail: now→then · today→that day · yesterday→the day before · tomorrow→the next day · here→there · this→that · ago→before。
cards.example: "I'll leave tomorrow." → She said she would leave the next day.

cards.detail: 一般疑问用 asked if / whether；特殊疑问保留疑问词——两种都恢复陈述语序（G33）。
cards.example: "Where do you live?" → He asked where I lived.

cards.detail: told / asked sb to do；否定是 not to do——not 站 to 前（G30），don't 不进转述。
cards.example: "Don't be late!" → She told us not to be late.

cards.detail: say + 内容；tell + 人（+内容）——tell 后面必须先有人。

basic.cn: 他说他累了。（原话："I am tired."）

basic.en: She said she liked the song.
basic.cn: 她说她喜欢这首歌。（原话："I like this song."）

basic.en: Mum told me to wash my hands.
basic.cn: 妈妈叫我洗手。（原话："Wash your hands!"）

basic.en: He asked if I was free.
basic.cn: 他问我是否有空。（原话："Are you free?"）
她问我住哪儿。（原话："Where do you live?"）

mid.en: Tom said he would come the next day.
mid.cn: 汤姆说他第二天来。（原话："I will come tomorrow."）

mid.en: She said she was practising then.
mid.cn: 她说她当时正在练习。（原话："I am practising now."）

mid.en: The teacher told us not to be late.
mid.cn: 老师叫我们别迟到。（原话："Don't be late!"）

mid.en: He asked what time the show started.
Amy said she had lost her ticket the day before.
mid.cn: 艾米说她前一天把票弄丢了。（原话："I lost my ticket yesterday."）

trap.en: He said he would call me that evening.
trap.cn: 他说那天晚上会给我打电话。
trap.note: 原话 "I will call you this evening."——will→would、this→that、you→me，三样各退。

trap.en: The teacher said the earth goes around the sun.
trap.cn: 老师说地球绕着太阳转。
trap.note: 客观真理豁免——转述也不退时态（G33 的老朋友）。

trap.en: She told me she was leaving.
trap.note: tell 后面必须先带人（told me）；say 不带人。

trap.en: He asked me not to touch the drum.
trap.note: 祈使的否定转述——not 站 to 前（G30），don't 不进转述。

trap.en: She asked if I had seen her scarf.
trap.cn: 她问我有没有见过她的围巾。
trap.note: 原话 "Have you seen my scarf?"——收起问句手势坐正，现完退成过完。

trap.en: He said he had finished the day before.
trap.cn: 他说他前一天就完成了。
trap.note: 「昨天」离开现场就失效——换算成 the day before。

redBlack.bad: Tom said I will help you.（转述原话 "I will help you."——汤姆要帮我）
redBlack.good: Tom said he would help me.
redBlack.why: 人称不换算，「谁帮谁」全反——汤姆的好意成了你自己的承诺。

redBlack.bad: He said he will come tomorrow.（转述上周说的话）
redBlack.good: He said he would come the next day.
redBlack.why: 上周的「明天」早过去了——不换算成 the next day，听的人会记错日子白等一场。

redBlack.bad: He said me that he was busy.
redBlack.good: He told me that he was busy.
redBlack.why: say 不带人——想带人得换 tell。

redBlack.bad: She asked me where did I buy the drum.
redBlack.good: She asked me where I bought the drum.
redBlack.why: 转述的问句要坐正——did 退场，过去式回到 buy 身上（G33）。

redBlack.bad: The teacher told us don't run in the hall.
redBlack.good: The teacher told us not to run in the hall.
redBlack.why: 祈使转述用 (not) to do——don't 不进转述。

redBlack.bad: He asked me that I liked music.
redBlack.good: He asked me if I liked music.
redBlack.why: 问「是不是」用 if / whether——that 只接陈述。

redBlack.bad: She said she is watching TV then.
redBlack.good: She said she was watching TV then.
redBlack.why: 转述过去说的话——时态跟着退一步。

redBlack.bad: Amy said she had lost her key yesterday.（转述上周说的话）
redBlack.good: Amy said she had lost her key the day before.
redBlack.why: 离开现场「昨天」失效——换算成 the day before。

redBlack.bad: He told he would come soon.
redBlack.good: He told me he would come soon.
redBlack.why: tell 后面必须先有人——没人就换 say。

redBlack.bad: Mum asked me to don't stay up late.
redBlack.good: Mum asked me not to stay up late.
redBlack.why: 否定祈使的转述——not 站 to 前，don't 退场。

redBlack.bad: He said that he was tired.（有人说 that 必须省略）
redBlack.good: 带 that / 省 that 都对。
redBlack.why: 转述陈述句的 that 是 G33 那条可选安全带——不设坑。

redBlack.bad: She asked if I was free.（有人说转述只能用 whether）
redBlack.why: 转述一般疑问两个都通用——不挡意思不设坑。

contrast.cn: 他说：「我明天来。」→ 他说他明天来。（只换人称）
contrast.en: He said he would come the next day.
contrast.diff: 中文只换「我→他」；英语连时态、时间词一起换算。

contrast.cn: 他问我住哪儿。（「住哪儿」原样搬）
contrast.diff: 英语要坐正 + 退时态；中文什么都不用动。
英语把「说」拆成两家——tell 后面必须先有人。

contrast.cn: 妈妈叫我别熬夜。（一个「别」字）
contrast.en: Mum asked me not to stay up late.
contrast.diff: 中文的「别」；英语转述里换成 not to do。

contrast.cn: 他说地球绕太阳转。（本来就没什么可退）
contrast.en: He said the earth goes around the sun.
contrast.diff: 英语本该退时态，但真理豁免——两边难得一致。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 人称换立场，时态退一步，时空换算好；问句坐正，命令 to do。
steps: 换人称：他嘴里的 I，到你嘴里是 he / she——一律换到你的立场。
退时态：is→was、will→would、can→could；主句是 says（现在）就不退。
换时空：now→then、today→that day、yesterday→the day before、tomorrow→the next day、here→there。
真理不退：客观事实保持一般现在。
转述问句：一般疑问 asked if / whether，特殊疑问保留疑问词——都要坐正。
转述命令：told / asked sb (not) to do；带人用 tell，不带人用 say。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，咱们玩传话游戏：我悄悄告诉你一句『指挥的话』，比如『我明天在这儿排练』，你用英语转述给玩偶听。我不懂英语没关系，我盯三件事的音：转述里不该再出现 I（除非你转述自己的话）；不该出现 tomorrow、now、here 这些『现场词』——它们都该换算掉；转述问句时不该有问句那种上扬的调子。」玩三轮：一轮陈述、一轮问句、一轮命令（『别迟到！』），听孩子有没有把命令说成 not to be late。最后互换：孩子当指挥说英语原话，我用中文转述——比比谁换算得快。
questions: 指挥说「I will rehearse here tomorrow」，转述时哪三样东西变了？各变成了什么？
「他问我是否有空」为什么用 asked if，不能用 asked that？
「老师叫我们别说话」里的「别」，转述时变成了什么？

sections.echo: 「三样各退一步」其实是同一条规律的三个面：I、now、here、tomorrow 这些词全是「以说话人为圆心」的坐标——语言学里叫指示语。换人转述就是换圆心，所有坐标一起平移。英语把这次平移明明白白写在词形上（would、then、there），中文则让听的人自己脑补——两种策略，一个道理。而 say 和 tell 这对最常用的「说」，正是「越常用分工越细」的又一例：高频词从不肯合并，各自守着自己的句型。转述是把 G33 的坐正与对表、G30 的 to do 拼在一起的综合练习——学到这里，前面的零件开始互相咬合了。

memoryCard.alt: G40 记忆卡：转述三样各退一步——人称换圆心、时态退一步（is→was/will→would/can→could）、时空词换算（now→then/today→that day/tomorrow→the next day/here→there）；问句转述坐正（if/whether 或疑问词）；命令转述 (not) to do；say+内容/tell+人；警示 said me、asked me that、told us don't、where did I live 四类错误。

questions.q: 直接引语和间接引语的区别是？
options: 录音回放 vs 替他转述
questions.explain: 引号里原封不动；转述要换圆心。

questions.q: 转述时「三样各退一步」指哪三样？
questions.explain: 换立场、退时态、换算时空词。

questions.q: He said, "I am tired." 转述成？
转述里 will 退成？
转述里 can 退成？
now 在转述里换算成？
today 在转述里换算成？
tomorrow 在转述里换算成？
yesterday 在转述里换算成？
here 在转述里换算成？
转述一般疑问句（是不是）用？
questions.explain: 问「是不是」——if / whether 领进门。

questions.q: 转述特殊疑问句时，疑问词后面的语序？
questions.explain: 收起问句手势——G33 的坐正。

questions.q: 转述祈使句「别迟到」用？
options: told us not to be late
said us not to be late
questions.explain: told sb not to do——don't 不进转述。

questions.q: say 和 tell 的分工是？
什么内容转述时不退时态？
questions.explain: 真理豁免——保持一般现在。

questions.q: "I like music," she said. 转述时 I 换成？
questions.explain: 换圆心——她嘴里的 I 是 she。

stages.name: 选一选 · 退一步填空

questions.q: He said he ___ tired after the show.
She said she ___ come the next day.
Tom said he ___ swim when he was five.
He told me he was practising ___.（原话：now）
She said she had seen the film ___.（原话：yesterday）
He said he would leave ___.（原话：tomorrow）
The teacher ___ us that practice makes progress.
He asked ___ I liked the new song.
She asked me where I ___.（原话：Where do you live?）
Mum told me ___ up my room.
questions.explain: 祈使转述——told sb to do。

questions.q: The coach told us ___ give up.
questions.explain: 否定祈使转述——not to give up。

questions.q: He ___ that he was from Sichuan.
He ___ me that he was from Sichuan.
She asked ___ time the concert started.
questions.explain: 问几点——保留疑问词 what time。

questions.q: He said the sun ___ in the east.
"Are you ready?" → He asked ___ we were ready.
哪一句转述对了？（原话："I am happy here."）
options: He said he was happy there.
He said I was happy here.
He said he is happy there.

questions.q: 哪一句转述对了？（原话："I will call you tonight."）
options: He said he would call me that night.
He said he will call you tonight.
He said he would call you tonight.

questions.q: 哪一句转述对了？（原话："Where do you live?"）
options: She asked me where I lived.
She asked me where did I live.
She asked me where I live.

questions.q: 哪一句转述对了？（原话："Don't run in the hallway!"）
options: The teacher told us not to run in the hallway.
The teacher told us don't run in the hallway.
The teacher said us not to run in the hallway.

questions.q: 哪一句转述对了？（原话："Are you free this Sunday?"）
options: He asked if I was free that Sunday.
He asked that I was free this Sunday.
He asked if I am free this Sunday.
questions.explain: if + 坐正 + 退一步 + this→that。

questions.q: 哪一句转述对了？（原话上周说："I lost my key yesterday."）
options: She said she had lost her key the day before.
She said she lost my key yesterday.
She said she had lost her key yesterday.
questions.explain: 退成过完 + yesterday 换算成 the day before。

questions.q: 哪一句转述对了？（原话："I can play the drums."）
options: He said he could play the drums.
He said he can play the drums.
He said I could play the drums.

questions.q: 哪一句转述对了？（原话："The earth goes around the sun."）
options: The teacher said the earth goes around the sun.
The teacher said the earth went around the sun.
The teacher said the earth had gone around the sun.

questions.q: 哪一句转述对了？（原话："Please come early."）
options: She asked me to come early.
She asked to me coming early.
questions.explain: 客气的请求转述——asked sb to do。

questions.q: 哪一句转述对了？（原话："What time does the show begin?"）
options: He asked what time the show began.
He asked what time did the show begin.
He asked what time the show begins.
questions.explain: 坐正 + begins 退成 began。

questions.q: 哪一句转述对了？（原话："I'm practising now."）
options: She said she was practising then.
She said she is practising now.
She said she was practising now.

questions.q: 哪一句 say/tell 用对了？（他告诉我他很忙）
options: He told me that he was busy.
He said me that he was busy.
He told that he was busy.
questions.explain: tell 必须带人；say 不带人。

questions.q: 哪一句转述对了？（原话："Do you have a spare ticket?"）
options: She asked whether I had a spare ticket.
She asked that I had a spare ticket.
She asked did I have a spare ticket.

questions.q: 哪一句转述对了？（原话妈妈对弟弟说："Don't touch the wires!"）
options: Mum told my brother not to touch the wires.
Mum told my brother to not touch the wires.
Mum told my brother don't touch the wires.
questions.explain: not to touch——not 站 to 前。

questions.q: 哪一句转述对了？（原话："I will wait for you here."）
options: He said he would wait for me there.
He said he would wait for you here.
He said he will wait for me there.

questions.q: 哪一句转述对了？（原话："Why are you late?"）
options: The teacher asked why I was late.
The teacher asked why was I late.
The teacher asked why I am late.

questions.q: 大考："I will return the CD to you tomorrow," Tom said to me. → Tom told me ___.
options: he would return the CD to me the next day
he will return the CD to you tomorrow
I would return the CD to him the next day

questions.q: "Have you finished your homework?" → Mum asked ___.
options: if I had finished my homework
that I had finished my homework
if had I finished my homework
questions.explain: if + 坐正 + 现完退过完。

questions.q: "Practise here every day!" the coach said. → The coach told us ___ every day.
"I saw the singer at the airport this morning," she said. → She said she ___ the singer at the airport ___ morning.
"Where is the ticket office?" → He asked ___.
"Water boils at 100°C," the teacher said. → The teacher said water ___ at 100°C.
"Don't play games before homework," Dad said. → Dad told me ___ games before homework.
"Can you help me move the piano?" → He asked ___ him move the piano.
"I'm listening to the new album now," Amy said. → Amy said she ___ to the new album ___.
找错：哪句转述的人称错了？（原话 Lily 说："I will lend you my notes."）
options: Lily said I would lend her my notes.
Lily said she would lend me her notes.
Lily said she would lend me the notes.
questions.explain: 圆心没换——莉莉的许诺被转成了「我」的许诺。

questions.q: "My parents took me to the concert last week," he said. → He said his parents ___ him to the concert ___.
questions.explain: 退成过完；last week → the week before。

questions.q: "Is there a music room here?" → The new student asked ___ a music room there.
questions.explain: if + There be 退一步 + here→there。

questions.q: "You'd better not be late," the conductor said to us. → The conductor told us ___ late.
questions.explain: 劝告转述——told us not to be late。

questions.q: 找错：哪句 say / tell 用错了？
options: She said me the good news.
She told me the good news.
She said that the news was good.
questions.explain: say 不带人——said me 是串线。

questions.q: "I have lived here for ten years," the old man said. → The old man said he ___ there for ten years.
大考二："I can't find my sheet music. Did you see it yesterday?" → She said she ___ find her sheet music and asked ___ it ___.
options: couldn't / if I had seen / the day before
couldn't / that I had seen / the day before
questions.explain: can't→couldn't；问句用 if + 退一步；yesterday 换算。

detective.sentence: He said me that the rehearsal was cancelled.
detective.fixed: He told me that the rehearsal was cancelled.
detective.clue: say 不带人——带人得换 tell。

detective.sentence: She asked me where did I buy the hat.
detective.fixed: She asked me where I bought the hat.
detective.clue: 转述问句要坐正——did 退场，过去式回到 buy 身上。

detective.sentence: The teacher told us don't talk during the test.
detective.fixed: The teacher told us not to talk during the test.
detective.clue: 祈使转述用 not to do——don't 不进转述。

detective.sentence: He asked me that I had a pen to lend him.
detective.fixed: He asked me if I had a pen to lend him.
detective.clue: 问「有没有」用 if / whether——that 只接陈述。

detective.sentence: Amy said she will join the choir the next day.
detective.fixed: Amy said she would join the choir the next day.
detective.clue: said 已在过去——will 跟着退成 would。

detective.sentence: He told me he had watched the match yesterday.（转述上周说的话）
detective.fixed: He told me he had watched the match the day before.
detective.clue: 离开现场「昨天」失效——换算成 the day before。

detective.sentence: My cousin said I liked the song best.（原话：表哥说「我最喜欢这首歌」）
detective.fixed: My cousin said he liked the song best.
detective.clue: 圆心没换——表哥嘴里的 I，到你嘴里是 he。
